data.name: Qualities.Summary.5b19dbcd-fb69-4a02-a25a-7ac5342ca576
data.value: You spot patterns and connect clues. The bonus applies to analytical tasks such as investigating evidence or solving puzzles, not every Logic test.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.84305e09-f8d5-4a82-8257-0119b8c3f926
data.value: You move quietly and avoid attracting attention. This improves Sneaking tests; it does not make you invisible.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.db579224-99c7-48e0-84ab-77a987a84f4a
data.value: Your flexible joints help you slip out of restraints. The bonus applies to Escape Artist tests.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.225f0d31-8c03-4283-9a22-558ab01a6c47
data.value: Running and acrobatics come naturally to you. You gain bonuses to Running and Gymnastics, rather than a general increase to physical attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.58e3d62a-2073-4af5-b8e0-00c446b3a5ab
data.value: Choose a skill with exceptional potential. Its maximum rating increases; this does not grant a free skill level or bonus dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2ac8a95a-a4d0-4bef-a2f2-dcde020258cf
data.value: Choose an attribute other than Edge. Its natural maximum increases, giving you room to improve it further; its current value does not rise automatically.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c734e46a-d391-45a6-b022-6f18db5019f1
data.value: You grew up speaking two native languages. The additional native-language slot is not a bonus to every language skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9f25cc0a-c47c-49dd-953c-8fe60628bae8
data.value: You make a strong first impression. The social skill bonus applies when meeting someone for the first time, not to every later conversation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b7866fb4-3747-4caf-9240-69cbdd79ce78
data.value: You keep functioning despite injuries. Wound penalties start later; damage is still recorded normally and this does not heal you.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.78f7456d-78b8-461e-a2b2-bd0d63c48712
data.value: Your potential for good fortune is unusually high. Your Edge maximum increases, but you still need to buy the extra point.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9d3be1d9-1309-45e7-8bd9-1f5a3ede3522
data.value: You recall information and details more easily. This improves memory tests rather than granting knowledge you never learned.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.291efdb6-a8b8-49ce-b2be-72f9d3f8a243
data.value: You recover well from injuries and exhaustion. Bonuses apply to healing you, including the listed Heal spell test; they do not improve healing other people.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00cc6499-db13-447e-8116-278d317a9e31
data.value: You withstand punishment better. The damage-resistance bonus helps you resist incoming damage; it is not extra armor.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.18d2a522-6460-4654-916b-a96631f11323
data.value: You can survive more overflow damage after your Physical condition monitor fills. This does not prevent unconsciousness or remove injuries.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.9d53e1e4-3f31-40cb-bfbe-4b94f5ba757e
data.value: Your talent combines magician abilities with adept powers. Choose and pay for the permitted spells, skills and powers in the Magic step; this entry does not grant every ability for free.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.55247bdc-c313-4614-ae15-5012308096ff
data.value: You channel magic into adept powers. Select your powers in the Magic step; being an adept does not by itself make you a spellcaster.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c4b35412-bd91-45b4-b428-29da7edd5ff4
data.value: You access the Matrix through a living persona and Resonance abilities. The Computer bonus shown here is specifically for Matrix Perception.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.25356bae-efcc-46c6-9c4f-66909b9b7233
data.value: An unpleasant reputation precedes you. Your Notoriety increases and can affect how others react to your runner.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1bad26cf-9d67-4bb1-9b4f-e9c80d668651
data.value: You notice details others miss, both with your senses and when reading an aura. The bonuses apply to Perception and Assensing.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e96c7280-b9b0-4112-8b65-a3568c7ca13e
data.value: Stress can make your hands shake. When triggered, an Agility + Body test determines whether you keep them steady; while shaking, Agility-based tests take a −2 dice penalty.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ba27345f-0e68-4660-9b76-2b999c3a4161
data.value: Controlling a vehicle directly is difficult for you: Piloting tests take a −2 dice penalty while you are in direct control.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0a7bcb95-dd9c-4e3e-ab0a-291a352ac1d4
data.value: You are especially vulnerable to disease. Pathogens affect you at increased Power; this is a drawback, not a resistance bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8ba2830a-3f10-4877-9752-93be051b205b
data.value: A particular social situation causes you intense stress. In that situation, Leadership and Etiquette tests are more likely to glitch.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5150f4f0-5193-4f02-8914-d70e831e3567
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Gymnastics instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.1d0c4278-501d-456f-ab63-69afee6fbf95
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Agility instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b5f6d958-2563-431b-a7a4-a9028a9f0277
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Perception instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0c23861e-36d1-4454-b327-0d8118d02d60
data.value: When using Full Defense, you can rely on Charisma instead of Willpower. It still costs Initiative and is not a permanent defense bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0f3a0971-1cc5-47d6-a32d-d098ecdfb4d9
data.value: Your Mental limit increases, allowing more hits to count on tests capped by that limit. This raises the cap, not your dice pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.58e6a651-cdd7-4144-a2cc-4cee24526e92
data.value: Your Physical limit increases, allowing more hits to count on tests capped by that limit. This does not raise your physical attributes.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b9f1dbeb-1728-4250-a066-4773f758fe6a
data.value: Your Social limit increases, allowing more hits to count on tests capped by that limit. This is not a bonus to every social dice pool.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e160111a-5fe3-4154-9d5a-82330c9b32fc
data.value: You resist pathogens more effectively, whether exposure comes through contact, ingestion, inhalation or injection. Resistance helps with the test; it is not complete immunity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c74c9ed8-a917-4809-9e8a-5717dd16619b
data.value: You resist toxins more effectively through all four exposure routes. The bonus applies to toxin resistance, not to damage resistance in general.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2b9a495d-b735-416b-a000-f648c3b4191a
data.value: Someone depends on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 10%; it does not grant extra starting money.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cc857826-3bb2-466d-987b-7d56a337bc08
data.value: Someone depends on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 20%; the extra expense continues with that lifestyle.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.066a2de9-1717-44ca-a8c6-90366890574a
data.value: Someone places substantial demands on your support. This level raises lifestyle costs by 30%, rather than charging a one-time fee.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.13fd45c3-e031-4452-8bf8-31829d2401f9
data.value: Your body handles augmentation poorly. Cyberware costs twice the normal Essence, and bioware is unavailable.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f0873c37-4f09-41cd-be81-88e8df5b42ae
data.value: Social training costs twice as many creation points or Karma. Social skill groups are unavailable, so you cannot use a group purchase to avoid those costs. Your Notoriety also increases.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d8362a78-54e9-4dbe-8388-6ba0a7b9df31
data.value: Academic, professional and technical learning is harder for you. The listed skills and specializations cost twice the normal Karma, and you cannot default in those categories. Technical skill-group training also costs more.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.ce939b04-5fc6-49e9-a747-9c9d1254449e
data.value: You may obtain one item with Availability up to 24. This is an exception to the availability restriction, not a free item; its normal price still matters.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7706ce23-77c2-470f-bb7e-6a4e56fa78fe
data.value: This drawback penalizes Logic- and Intuition-based tests, memory, reading intentions, defense and surprise. It also weakens the listed magical and addiction resistance tests. Each listed penalty follows the quality's rating.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0c11aefb-2306-43e9-9588-a84a563e9025
data.value: Bony spikes make your unarmed attacks more dangerous. They add 2 to unarmed damage and change that damage to Physical.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.51ba5e67-f2fd-4149-b24c-9b502ed0e7c7
data.value: You gain a pair of additional arms. This describes extra limbs, not two additional actions or a blanket attack bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.23bfa65d-9241-4183-b7ea-0e2935e42f29
data.value: Cyberware integrates more easily with your body. Its Essence cost is 90% of normal; this does not reduce its nuyen price.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.dcecd7e5-8cf1-4f83-89fa-177e28cfba03
data.value: Bioware integrates more easily with your body. Its Essence cost is 90% of normal; this does not reduce its nuyen price.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00c827f6-aaa7-4003-87c9-f14e36263252
data.value: You gain 2 dice to resist developing a new physical or psychological addiction. This does not grant the same bonus once that addiction already exists.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.0ebdfce5-c613-4fd9-9763-cae2d21c2153
data.value: Your Essence contributes to your recovery. Add it to tests for healing Physical damage and recovering from Stun damage.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.00ae8fce-15aa-4a7f-90e3-9336824a626e
data.value: You are more vulnerable to addiction: physical and psychological addiction resistance tests take a 2-dice penalty. It applies both before an addiction develops and when one already exists.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.919cc565-a5b6-4eda-addb-afa2e293af24
data.value: You read the room instinctively. Etiquette tests use Intuition as their attribute instead of the usual attribute; this does not change every social skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2c1aff52-95e2-43f5-98ea-c653c66b7ee7
data.value: People find your intentions harder to read. You gain 2 dice when resisting Judge Intentions; it does not improve your own ability to read someone else.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.41416949-62eb-4638-9457-fd7e833cea58
data.value: You rely on reasoning in diplomatic negotiations. The Diplomacy specialization of Negotiation uses Logic instead of the usual attribute; other Negotiation specializations are unchanged.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e508350b-f61d-4878-bd6d-98f8c9e3588b
data.value: You gain Alter Ballistics as an alchemical spell. It is an alchemical option, not a permanent damage bonus to every firearm.

data.value: Essence adjustment for Magic loss only

data.value: Extra earned Karma needed per Street Cred

data.value: Half the rating, rounded up; touch range only

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bd2cf8ea-4eb3-458c-aa04-2de47067f3ad
data.value: You cover ground faster. Your base walking and running multipliers become 3 and 6 times Agility, and each sprinting hit adds one extra meter. These are movement changes, not bonus dice.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.5451c3da-b08c-4a63-899f-afb62bd50a57
data.value: Your legs improve running on land: the base running multiplier becomes six times Agility, and each sprinting hit adds one extra meter. This does not increase your walking multiplier.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c6a2aa0f-76fd-432b-85bb-3ef2c2857525
data.value: You build Street Cred more slowly. Earned Karma contributes one point per 20 Karma rather than per 10; this does not multiply your Street Cred by ten.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.f6a8d504-db7a-47eb-ace5-604de21c80fd
data.value: Essence loss reduces your special attribute at 20% of the normal rate. This modifier changes the attribute loss, not the Essence cost or nuyen price of an augmentation.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.742caf46-a10b-4aa1-a6bc-a53feb99748c
data.value: You gain a free-spell allowance equal to half your Magic, rounded up. Those spells must have Touch range, including touch-area spells; this is not permission to choose spells at any range.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.bbc6879e-b50d-4862-b85c-a86c5b9e5d67
data.value: You specialize in spellcasting. Your free-spell allowance follows your Spellcasting rating, and learning a new spell costs one less Karma. Summoning and Binding are unavailable.

data.value: You receive a rating-3 fake SIN with four rating-3 fake licenses. These supplied items have no additional nuyen cost; they are not a genuine registered identity.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.fd9b9b6d-c969-40f1-8dc7-61f8e5d9cd4d
data.value: Choose a free expertise specialization in Artisan. Its benefit is tied to the chosen specialty, rather than granting a free Artisan rating or improving every use of the skill.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.7297d8b0-8bb8-4d7a-ab10-2d4e4381e5d0
data.value: Your membership supplies a group contact with Connection 5 and fixed Loyalty 3. This granted contact does not use contact points; the fixed Loyalty takes precedence over its base value.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.81fc0829-3456-4701-8ecc-f101d145b538
data.value: Choose an eligible skill. Weapons using that skill gain 1 Accuracy, increasing their limit rather than their attack dice pool. The skill-choice restrictions are shown below.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.8c49fcfb-54fa-43ce-b2af-51780dabf40f
data.value: You can choose two additional spirit types to summon, but cannot use Binding. These are additions to the kinds of spirits available to you, not two already-summoned spirits or two owed services.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2a599984-62e4-4110-9784-dc1922df395d
data.value: You cannot use Spellcasting. For every two full points of your base Summoning skill, choose one additional summonable spirit type. These choices do not summon spirits or grant services.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.c1d4d7ec-9ebb-4e85-ae72-8155b0f27478
data.value: You gain access to Magic and the Sorcery and Conjuring skills, but your spell choices are limited to one chosen category and summoning to one chosen spirit type. This does not grant free spells or spirits.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.d03a9696-2341-4894-8cf2-0537c4e74af2
data.value: Choose one spell category other than Rituals. Spells in that chosen category have their Drain reduced by 2; Rituals remain additionally permitted. The Conjuring skill group is unavailable.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.cfc637e9-0071-4313-a25b-b411793f2321
data.value: Combat spells gain 1 damage and also cause 1 more Drain. Choose one eligible combat skill for a separate +1 weapon-damage modifier. Neither effect adds dice to attack tests.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.4d5e0fd2-dab3-4de0-9756-096a748bb3cc
data.value: Your spell choices are limited to one chosen category, and your summoning to air spirits. The Enchanting skill group is unavailable. Choosing the type does not grant an already-summoned spirit.

data.value: Your spell choices are limited to one chosen category, and your summoning to fire spirits. The Enchanting skill group is unavailable. Choosing the type does not grant an already-summoned spirit.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.2656bcd7-3fe1-4c34-a4fb-89ebebfbf016
data.value: A trust fund can cover an eligible Medium lifestyle when assigned to it. The level I is a support category, not a one-nuyen payment or an attribute bonus. Any additional income is not described by this source data.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.36d761de-b423-4610-b8e4-026e7e78a3bf
data.value: A trust fund can cover an eligible Low lifestyle when assigned to it. Level II does not pay for a higher lifestyle automatically. Any additional income is not described by this source data.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e03653d0-6c53-4835-a3f6-baa0908d53c9
data.value: A trust fund can cover an eligible High lifestyle when assigned to it. This is lifestyle support, not free equipment or a bonus to starting nuyen. Any additional income is not described by this source data.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.79835078-5e76-4431-902f-02fdc4990ac9
data.value: A trust fund can cover an eligible Medium lifestyle when assigned to it. Level IV does not mean four free lifestyles or four times the starting funds. Any additional income is not described by this source data.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.b47319f5-372d-4e23-9fd9-a8e4aecd4c85
data.value: Pairs of eligible cyberlimbs strengthen your Willpower: +1 per complete pair, up to +2. Only limbs counted by the active cyberlimb settings qualify; a single limb or unrelated implant does not grant this bonus.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.38deea18-76f0-49a3-95ba-50006e4e7f90
data.value: Each complete pair of eligible cyberlimbs adds 1 to Agility and Strength, up to +2 each. The trade-off is three fewer Physical condition boxes per pair, up to six fewer boxes. Only limbs counted by the active cyberlimb settings qualify; this is not an unconditional attribute increase.

data.name: Qualities.Summary.e07fc29c-55cc-46b3-af56-3b1de76f0a89
data.value: You have access to influential contacts during creation. A separate pool of four times your Charisma pays for individual contacts with Connection 8 or higher, and the creation-time Connection ceiling rises to 12. This pool does not buy group contacts or increase every contact's Loyalty.
